dogecoin.text: BREAKING: Analysts predict a 60% chance that Dogecoin will hit $1 by January 31, with traders anticipating a 140% rally before February.
Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency launches official website featuring Dogecoin logo, sparking a Dogecoin rally.
BREAKING: Bitwise officially files with SEC for a spot Dogecoin ETF, marking a significant step in bringing Dogecoin to traditional finance markets.
